Annals-2100-Solar War | January - April: On the 2nd of January 2100, contact with mining colonies was suddenly lost. Shortly after, multiple unknown spaceships were detected entering the Solar System. 500 ships were estimated to have entered.||||The invaders quickly mobilized to attack Earth and prevent travel between planets. Military units on anti-space piracy operation were the first to make contact with the invaders.||||After a series of orbital bombardment, alien land forces were first deployed in Western Africa.||||By early February, most countries had basic plans to defend themselves against the invasion. The UK, Taiwan and Japan made extensive use of AA systems to limit damage from the bombardment and prevent land invasions.||||In March more land invasions were started and a few countries fell to them.||||Multiple attempts to regain full control of Earth's orbit were made in April, but they all failed.
Annals-2100-Solar War | May - August: Through April and May, more and more civilian spaceships were militarized to try and maintain some control over Earth's orbit. These ships proved to be effective enough to prevent landings in heavily defend area.||||At this point, most colonies were on the brink of starvation.||||Efforts to evacuate civilians became more organized and many countries started conscription around this time. Fighting in Eastern Europe became fiercer.||||During the Summer, another landing attempt was made on North America. Local forces were unable to repel the second landing. The invaders managed to set up a presence in the Canadian Prairies and American Midwest.||||At the same time, most Asian and African countries were forced into guerrilla warfare to protect what was left.
Annals-2100-Solar War | September - Dece: In mid-September, a joint operation between some nations of Earth and the Moon and Mars colonies was carried out to temporarily secure the space near the Pacific Space Elevator. The main goal was to ship food to colonies in need.||||The operation was a big success and the area was never lost for the rest of the Solar War.||||Fighting on the surface of Earth started to reach a stalemate.||||During December, some colonists on Pluto intercepted strange communications and managed to get those reported back to Earth.||||Up to this point, most space colonies were either ignored, barely surviving or destroyed. Reports indicate that some space pirates rescued colonists and fought with small segments of the invader's fleet.||||Intel about how their ships worked and alien tech was gained by pirates and sold for a high profit.
Annals-2101-Solar War | January - April: On the 7th of January deploys the first 3 Espoir-class space battleship. These spaceship are anti-piracy spaceship fitted with heavy weapons for ship-to-ship combat. By the end of the month, they managed to sink the first 4 heavy invader spaceships of the war. This was a significant moral boost.||||The fighting on Earth's surface started to change, the invaders had more trouble resupplying troops on the ground thanks to changes in tactics from the human side.||||By April, human forces started to encounter heavily fortified positions build by the invaders. Progress came to a standstill again.
Annals-2101-Solar War | May - August: Throughout May, more unknown spaceships were identified in the edges of the Solar System. These send communications claiming that they came to fight the invaders.||||At first, people thought that mankind would just be destroyed or enslaved by another alien race. But after a very important diplomatic meeting on the Moon, these fears were quelled.||||The plan was for humanity to stay on the defensive while our new benefactors would attack key parts of the invader fleet.||||The strategy proved itself effective during the summer. It helped humanity build up forces in space and carry out more aggressive ground campaigns. The first lines of heavy fortifications were destroyed during the first half of August.
Annals-2101-Solar War | September - Dece: The fighting continued like previously during September. But this time coalition forces interacted more with human forces.||||An operation was planned during October and set in action in November to attack the invader mothership. Strategists from the tailurian-reptilian coalition claimed that destroying it was the quickest path to victory.||||The operation went well.||||During December as the war was seemingly coming to an end. Representative of the tailurian-reptilian coalition approached the government of a few nations to see if they wanted to join their military alliance.||||Most accepted, the terms were reasonable and didn't put humanity's sovereignty in danger. The technology exchanges were very attractive.
Annals-2102-End of the Solar War: The destruction of the invader mothership signaled the end of the Solar War. Most invader forces fell in disarray and were whittled down bit by bit.||||Around 80 invader spaceship are said to have disappeared in the asteroid belts. Searches for these are on going as they are probably still a significant threat.||||Humanity was battered and traumatized. It's estimated that 20 to 35 percent of the total human population died.||||Despite all this, humanity probably has an even brighter future now. We now have access to FTL space travel, many new technologies and seemingly reliable allies.
Annals-2102-Human FTLT system integratio: Before the Solar War, humanity still relied on radio technology. This has multiple issues for a multiplanet civilization.||||First, a line of sight is required. This can be worked around by making use of relay stations.||Second, communication lag. On average, it takes 13 minutes for a transmission to reach Mars from Earth and another 13 for Earth to receive a response.||||There was no work around until mankind was introduced and integrated into the Faster Than Light Transmission system, FTLT for short, by the tailurian-reptilian coalition.||||The FTLT system uses the same principles as the Pandora FTL Engine used by the tailurian-reptilian coalition and now mankind. The biggest difference is that the FTLT system makes longer 'jumps' through space since the transmissions are more resilient to potential deformations.||||If we did the same thing with spaceships, you'd hear about people turning into goo and ships into scrap on a daily basis.
Annals-2103-Humans Move to Zoar: When joining the Coalition, some humans government managed to secure deals to send war refugees to settle on smaller less established colonies.
